title: Wanting But Unable: (よ)うにも…ない, (よ)うか…まいか, そうにもない, どうにも…ない, ても始まらない, ないまでも, てもどうにもならない
description: Want to but can't, whether to or not, not looking at all likely, no way at all, no use, even if not fully, and nothing can be done.

points.title: (よ)うにも〜ない: want to but can't
points.summary: Volitional + にも + potential negative = even if you try to A, you can't.
points.body: - 連絡しよう**にも**、電話番号がわから**ない**.
examples: {動|うご}こうにも{動|うご}けなかった。
I wanted to move, but I just couldn't.

points.title: (よ)うか〜まいか: whether to or not
points.summary: Volitional + か + dictionary form + まいか = undecided whether to do A.
points.body: - 行こう**か**行く**まいか**、まだ迷っている.
examples: {言|い}おうか{言|い}うまいか{悩|なや}んだ。
I agonised over whether to say it or not.

points.title: 〜そうにもない: doesn't look at all likely
points.summary: ます-stem + そうにもない = there's no sign it will happen (stronger そうにない).
points.body: - この仕事は今日中に終わり**そうにもない**.
examples: {雨|あめ}はやみそうにもない。
The rain shows no sign of stopping.

points.title: どうにも〜ない: no way at all
points.summary: どうにも + negative = it can't be helped / nothing works.
points.body: - この痛みは薬を飲んでも**どうにも**ならない.
examples: {眠|ねむ}くてどうにもならない。
I'm so sleepy I can't do a thing about it.

points.title: 〜ても始まらない: no use
points.summary: て-form + も始まらない = doing A won't help now.
points.body: - 今更後悔して**も始まらない**.
examples: {泣|な}いても{始|はじ}まらない。

points.title: 〜ないまでも: even if not (fully), at least
points.summary: ない-form + までも = not as far as A, but at least B.
points.body: - 毎日とは言わ**ないまでも**、週に一度は運動しなさい.
examples: {完璧|かんぺき}ではないまでも、よくできている。
It's not perfect, but it's well done.

points.title: 〜てもどうにもならない: nothing can be done
points.summary: て-form + も + どうにもならない = no matter how much you A, it changes nothing.
points.body: - 過ぎたことを悔やんで**もどうにもならない**.
examples: {一人|ひとり}で{悩|なや}んでもどうにもならないよ。
Worrying on your own won't get you anywhere.

questions.prompt: {連絡|れんらく}しよう（　）、{電話番号|でんわばんごう}がわからない。
questions.explanation: Want to but can't: **(よ)うにも**.
notes: しようとも = 'even if one tries' — doesn't fit 'I can't because I don't know'.
questions.translation: I'd like to get in touch, but I don't know the number.

questions.prompt: What does 「{動|うご}こうにも{動|うご}けなかった。」 mean?
options: Even if I move, I'll get stuck.
I tried moving and managed it.
I wanted to move, but I just couldn't.
questions.explanation: うにも…ない = **can't, though you try**.

questions.prompt: {行|い}こうか{行|い}く（　）か、まだ{迷|まよ}っている。
questions.explanation: Whether to or not: **うか…まいか**.
notes: 行くべきか = 'whether I should go' — breaks the pair.
まじ isn't the form here.
questions.translation: I still can't decide whether to go or not.

questions.prompt: What does 「{言|い}おうか{言|い}うまいか{悩|なや}んだ。」 mean?
options: I decided not to say it.
I agonised over whether to say it or not.
I said it, then regretted it.
Someone told me not to say it.
questions.explanation: うか…まいか = **whether or not to**.

questions.prompt: この{仕事|しごと}は{今日中|きょうじゅう}に{終|お}わり（　）。
questions.explanation: Not at all likely: **そうにもない**.
notes: そうでもない = 'not really so' — not about likelihood.
ようにもない isn't a pattern.
questions.translation: There's no way this job will be done today.

questions.prompt: What does 「{雨|あめ}はやみそうにもない。」 mean?
options: It doesn't seem to be raining.
The rain shows no sign of stopping.
It seems the rain has stopped.
questions.explanation: そうにもない = **no sign of**.
notes: やみそうにもない = not stopping.

questions.prompt: この{痛|いた}みは{薬|くすり}を{飲|の}んでも（　）ならない。
questions.explanation: No way at all: **どうにも…ない**.
notes: どうにかならない = 'can't something be done?' (a wish).
questions.translation: This pain won't go away even with medicine.

questions.prompt: What does 「{眠|ねむ}くてどうにもならない。」 mean?
options: I'm so sleepy I can't do a thing about it.
questions.explanation: どうにもならない = **nothing helps**.

questions.prompt: {今更|いまさら}{後悔|こうかい}して（　）。
questions.translation: There's no point regretting it now.

questions.prompt: What does 「{泣|な}いても{始|はじ}まらない。」 mean?
{毎日|まいにち}とは{言|い}わ（　）、{週|しゅう}に{一度|いちど}は{運動|うんどう}しなさい。
questions.explanation: Even if not fully: **ないまでも**.
questions.translation: I won't say every day, but at least exercise once a week.

questions.prompt: What does 「{完璧|かんぺき}ではないまでも、よくできている。」 mean?
options: It's not well done at all.
It's not perfect, but it's well done.
Until it's perfect, it's not done.

questions.prompt: {過|す}ぎたことを{悔|く}やんで（　）。
questions.explanation: Nothing can be done: **てもどうにもならない**.
notes: どうにかなる = 'it'll work out' — regretting doesn't fix the past.

questions.prompt: What does 「{一人|ひとり}で{悩|なや}んでもどうにもならないよ。」 mean?
options: Worrying on your own won't get you anywhere.
Worry on your own, and it'll be fine.
questions.explanation: てもどうにもならない = **pointless**.
